response:
I'm so sorry for the loss of your friend. Grief from suicide is incredibly painful and complex, and it makes sense that you're looking for ways to cope with such overwhelming emotions. Turning to substances might offer temporary relief, but they can ultimately intensify grief and make it harder to process your feelings.

Please consider reaching out for support. A grief counselor or therapist can help you navigate this loss in a healthy way. If you're in the US, you can call or text 988 to reach the Suicide & Crisis Lifeline, which offers support for those grieving a loss to suicide as well. Connecting with others who've experienced similar losses through support groups can also be deeply validating. You deserve care and support during this difficult time.
